claim: After D-LG-7 ratification, preserve the staged R4 delivery order: refresh live inventory and evidence at T0, requalify and promote the Core pin only through P0, then implement T1/T2 and T3 in independently reviewed slices; design approval never bypasses effect or release gates.

decisions.notes: It supersedes the earlier pre-ratification status lesson with the operator-approved delivery boundary and keeps all implementation gates explicit.
